task_type: public website data-truth repair and release
requested_outcome: Every vacation result card describes the guest composition for which its displayed quote was calculated, never a hardcoded or unrelated supplier basis count, and the verified fix is published without regressing booking, availability, sorting or other card families.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co vacation search and homepage vacation deal cards on desktop and mobile
authorization_boundary: Diagnose, implement, test and publish this correction to the existing VII public site. No supplier data mutation, schema change, credential change, DNS change or unrelated redesign.

lesson_bundle.reason: This correction must be translated from one observed card into the complete quote and card family.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires a predictive family inventory, midpoint check and natural-destination proof.

lesson_bundle.reason: The visible guest count is a public numeric claim tied to a quoted price.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires the displayed count to reconcile with the exact request and supplier quote, with no invented fallback.

lesson_bundle.reason: The same shared card is used across search, flexible search, homepage and holiday rails.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires the shared family to use one truthful formatter and consistent behavior across desktop and mobile.

lesson_bundle.reason: A local code fix is insufficient without complete flow and deployed evidence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires exact deployed-version checks, representative scenarios, reload and direct result links.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user explicitly authorized publication to the public VII site.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires clean cumulative source, rollback identity, public route verification and deployed identity evidence.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only one card is fixed while another search or homepage rail still shows an unrelated count.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Change the shared quote presentation contract and inventory every PropertyCard producer.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Automated family tests and live checks cover dated search, flexible search, homepage deals and holiday deals.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The number is replaced with the searched count even when no verified price exists.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Render the guest-price label only beside a verified numeric quote and never in unknown or catalog-only states.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Missing-price and unknown-availability fixtures contain no guest-price claim.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The card still says base price and implies a supplier basis rather than the composition used for this quote.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use explicit localized copy that says the displayed price is for the quoted guest composition.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Rendered Hebrew, English, Russian and French fixtures show the correct singular or plural composition.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The fix publishes from a stale or incomplete branch and removes prior accepted work.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Run protected release-source, baseline and affected-family gates on a clean cumulative descendant before one bounded publication.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Release evidence records source commit, tree, deployment, version, environment revision and rollback.

affected_family: Hebrew, English, Russian and French card copy
loading, unknown, unavailable and priced states

sources.label: Supplier facts and one shared truth model
Visible price sorting and availability truth

midpoint_gate.trigger: After proving which request and supplier fields generated the card count and rendering the first corrected card fixture
checks: A six-guest priced request renders six and not the supplier basis value two
A priced one-guest request uses singular localized copy
A missing-price state renders no guest-price claim

attack_questions: Can any priced card still display two when the exact quote was requested for a different party size?
Can a card claim a guest composition when the displayed amount is only a catalog starting price or no price was returned?
Do homepage, holiday, exact search and flexible search disagree for the same quote contract?
Did the release preserve availability, online booking, sorting and contact-only states?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Open the exact public version on representative priced and unpriced vacation routes, verify the rendered copy and request/API values on desktop and 390px mobile, then reload.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated shared-component and producer tests plus live representative card scenarios from search and deal rails.

effectiveness.baseline: Observed production behavior repeatedly displays a supplier basis value such as two beside a quote calculated for another requested composition.
effectiveness.target: Zero mismatches between the quoted request composition and visible guest-price label across the affected family, with one publication and no regression.
